## Read in and prepare data

```{r}
# load required libraries (install if necessary)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lme4) 
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
library(mlVAR)
library(datawizard)
library(psych)
library(ggplot2)
library(easystats)
library(jtools)
```

```{r}
# read in data
d_text <- read.csv("raw_data_syntactic_features_April 2026_pattern_LIWC.csv", fileEncoding='UTF-8-BOM')
```

```{r}
# filter data
d_text <- d_text[d_text$WC >= 15, ]
dim(d_text)
```

## Calculate linguistic distancing variables from LIWC

```{r}
# z-score relevant LIWC variables
d_text$Zi <- standardize(d_text$i)
d_text$Zfocuspresent <- standardize(d_text$focuspresent)
d_text$Zarticle <- standardize(d_text$article)
d_text$Zdiscrep <- standardize(d_text$discrep)
d_text$ZBigWords <- standardize(d_text$BigWords)
```

```{r}
# reverse score necessary variables
d_text$Zi_rev <- d_text$Zi*-1
d_text$Zfocuspresent_rev <- d_text$Zfocuspresent*-1
d_text$Zdiscrep_rev <- d_text$discrep*-1
```

```{r}
# function to average variables
rowwise_mean <- function(d_subset) {
  Reduce(`+`, d_subset) / ncol(d_subset)
}
d_text$distance_fullLIWC <- rowwise_mean(d_text[, c("Zi_rev", "Zfocuspresent_rev", "Zarticle", "Zdiscrep_rev", "ZBigWords")])
d_text$distance_partialLIWC <- rowwise_mean(d_text[, c("Zi_rev", "Zfocuspresent_rev")]) # using only first-person singular pronouns and past tense
```


## Calculate linguistic distancing variables from syntactic features

```{r}
# convert to percentages of total text length
d_text$pron_I_pct <- d_text$pron_I/d_text$WC*100
d_text$pron_me_pct <- d_text$pron_me/d_text$WC*100
d_text$pron_mine_pct <- d_text$pron_mine/d_text$WC*100
d_text$verb_npp_pct <- d_text$verb_npp/d_text$WC*100
d_text$verb_npi_pct <- d_text$verb_npi/d_text$WC*100
```

```{r}
# aggregate variables to compare with LIWC
d_text$i_pronouns <- d_text$pron_I_pct + d_text$pron_me_pct + d_text$pron_mine_pct # should be equivalent to i
d_text$nonpast_verbs <- d_text$verb_npp_pct + d_text$verb_npi_pct # should be equivalent to focuspresent
```

```{r}
# define new potential measure of linguistic distancing
d_text$Zpron_I_pct <- standardize(d_text$pron_I_pct)
d_text$Zverb_npi_pct <- standardize(d_text$verb_npi_pct)

d_text$Zpron_I_pct_rev <- d_text$Zpron_I_pct*-1
d_text$Zverb_npi_pct_rev <- d_text$Zverb_npi_pct*-1

d_text$distance_syntax <- rowwise_mean(d_text[, c("Zpron_I_pct_rev", "Zverb_npi_pct_rev")])
```


## Create correlation matrix of distancing variables

```{r}
d_corr_text_distance <- d_text[, c("distance_fullLIWC", "distance_partialLIWC", "distance_syntax", "i", "i_pronouns", "pron_I_pct", "pron_me_pct", "pron_mine_pct",
                         "focuspresent", "nonpast_verbs", "verb_npp_pct", "verb_npi_pct")]
```

```{r}
new_names_text_distance <- c("fLIWC", "pLIWC", "syntax", "iLIWC", "iPron", "I", "me", "mine", "npLIWC", "npVerb", "perf", "imperf")
colnames(d_corr_text_distance) <- new_names_text_distance
```

## Prepare variables for analyses at the momentary level

```{r}
# person-mean-center L1 variables for regression to separate within and between subjects variance
d_text <- d_text %>%
  group_by(connectionId) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_fullLIWC_w = distance_fullLIWC - mean(distance_fullLIWC, na.rm = TRUE),
    distance_partialLIWC_w = distance_partialLIWC - mean(distance_partialLIWC, na.rm = TRUE),
    iLIWC_w = i - mean(i, na.rm = TRUE),
    npLIWC_w = focuspresent - mean(focuspresent, na.rm = TRUE),
    distance_syntax_w = distance_syntax - mean(distance_syntax, na.rm = TRUE),
    polarity_w = polarity - mean(polarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    iPron_w = pron_I_pct - mean(pron_I_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    mePron_w = pron_me_pct - mean(pron_me_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    minePron_w = pron_mine_pct - mean(pron_mine_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    nppVerb_w = verb_npp_pct - mean(verb_npp_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    npiVerb_w = verb_npi_pct - mean(verb_npi_pct, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# standardize L1 variables
d_text$distance_fullLIWC_w_z = standardize(d_text$distance_fullLIWC_w)
d_text$distance_partialLIWC_w_z = standardize(d_text$distance_partialLIWC_w)
d_text$iLIWC_w_z = standardize(d_text$iLIWC_w)
d_text$npLIWC_w_z = standardize(d_text$npLIWC_w)
d_text$distance_syntax_w_z = standardize(d_text$distance_syntax_w)
d_text$polarity_w_z = standardize(d_text$polarity_w)
d_text$iPron_w_z = standardize(d_text$iPron_w)
d_text$mePron_w_z = standardize(d_text$mePron_w)
d_text$minePron_w_z = standardize(d_text$minePron_w)
d_text$nppVerb_w_z = standardize(d_text$nppVerb_w)
d_text$npiVerb_w_z = standardize(d_text$npiVerb_w)
```

```{r}
# standardize L2 variables separately
l2_std <- d_text %>%
  summarize(
    distance_fullLIWC_b = mean(distance_fullLIWC, na.rm = TRUE),
    distance_partialLIWC_b = mean(distance_partialLIWC, na.rm = TRUE),
    iLIWC_b = mean(i, na.rm = TRUE),
    npLIWC_b = mean(focuspresent, na.rm = TRUE),
    distance_syntax_b = mean(distance_syntax, na.rm = TRUE),
    polarity_b = mean(polarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    iPron_b = mean(pron_I_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    mePron_b = mean(pron_me_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    minePron_b = mean(pron_mine_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    nppVerb_b = mean(verb_npp_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    npiVerb_b = mean(verb_npi_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = connectionId) %>%
  mutate(
    distance_fullLIWC_b_z = standardize(distance_fullLIWC_b),
    distance_partialLIWC_b_z = standardize(distance_partialLIWC_b),
    iLIWC_b_z = standardize(iLIWC_b),
    npLIWC_b_z = standardize(npLIWC_b),
    distance_syntax_b_z = standardize(distance_syntax_b),
    polarity_b_z = standardize(polarity_b),
    iPron_b_z = standardize(iPron_b),
    mePron_b_z = standardize(mePron_b),
    minePron_b_z = standardize(minePron_b),
    nppVerb_b_z = standardize(nppVerb_b),
    npiVerb_b_z = standardize(npiVerb_b))
d_text <- d_text %>%
  left_join(l2_std, by = "connectionId")
```


## Run multilevel regression models

### initial null model

```{r}
mlm_null <- lmer(valence ~ 1 + (1|connectionId), data=d_text)
icc(mlm_null)
```
### full LIWC composite

```{r}
mlm_fullLIWC <- lmer(valence ~ distance_fullLIWC_w_z + (distance_fullLIWC_b_z|connectionId), data=d_text)
summary(mlm_fullLIWC)
# write.csv(tidy(mlm_fullLIWC, conf.int = TRUE),"mlm_fullLIWC.csv") # if you want to generate a spreadsheet table of the results
```

```{r}
mlm_fullLIWC_sentiment <- lmer(valence ~ distance_fullLIWC_w_z * polarity_w_z + (distance_fullLIWC_b_z * polarity_b_z|connectionId), data=d_text)
summary(mlm_fullLIWC_sentiment)
```

```{r}
# https://easystats.github.io/modelbased/reference/estimate_slopes.html 
#slopes_fullLIWC_sentiment <- estimate_slopes(mlm_fullLIWC_sentiment, trend = "distance_fullLIWC_w_z", by = "polarity_w_z = [sd]") # not working for some reason
slopes_fullLIWC_sentiment <- estimate_slopes(mlm_fullLIWC_sentiment, trend = "distance_fullLIWC_w_z", by = "polarity_w_z", length = 100)
summary(slopes_fullLIWC_sentiment)
```

## Run multilevel VAR models

```{r}
mlvar_fullLIWC <- mlVAR(d_text, vars = c("distance_fullLIWC","valence"), idvar="connectionId", lags=1, estimator="lmer", scale=TRUE, scaleWithin=TRUE)
summary(mlvar_fullLIWC, show=c("fit", "temporal", "contemporaneous"), round=3)
```

```{r}
mlvar_partialLIWC <- mlVAR(d_text, vars = c("distance_partialLIWC","valence"), idvar="connectionId", lags=1, estimator="lmer", scale=TRUE, scaleWithin=TRUE)
summary(mlvar_partialLIWC, show=c("fit", "temporal", "contemporaneous"), round=3)
```

```{r}
mlvar_syntax <- mlVAR(d_text, vars = c("distance_syntax","valence"), idvar="connectionId", lags=1, estimator="lmer", scale=TRUE, scaleWithin=TRUE)
summary(mlvar_syntax, show=c("fit", "temporal", "contemporaneous"), round=3)
```


## Read in and prepare data for analyses at the person level

```{r}
# read in questionnaire data
d_quest <- read_csv("All questionnaires_merged_no duplicate responses_all columns_updated scores_fixed IDs.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# aggregate all questionnaire assessments
d_person <- d_quest %>%
  summarize(
    PsychQOL_mean = mean(Psychological_Mean),
    DASS_mean = mean(DASS_Total),
    Depression_mean = mean(Depression),
    Anxiety_mean = mean(Anxiety),
    Stress_mean = mean(Stress),
    DIF_mean = mean(DIF),
    DDF_mean = mean(DDF),
    EOT_mean = mean(EOT),
    TAS_mean = mean(TAS_Total),
    TEIQ_mean = mean(TEIQ_Total),
    .by = alias)
```

```{r}
# standardize variables to assist with coefficient interpretation
d_person <- standardize(d_person, c("PsychQOL_mean", "DASS_mean", "Depression_mean", "Anxiety_mean", "Stress_mean", "DIF_mean", "DDF_mean", "EOT_mean", "TAS_mean", "TEIQ_mean"))
```

```{r}
# join with aggregated text-level predictors
d_text_agg <- d_text %>%
  summarize(
    distance_fullLIWC_b_z = mean(distance_fullLIWC_b_z),
    distance_partialLIWC_b_z = mean(distance_partialLIWC_b_z),
    distance_syntax_b_z = mean(distance_syntax_b_z),
    iLIWC_b_z = mean(iLIWC_b_z),
    npLIWC_b_z = mean(npLIWC_b_z),
    polarity_b_z = mean(polarity_b_z),
    iPron_b_z = mean(iPron_b_z),
    mePron_b_z = mean(mePron_b_z),
    minePron_b_z = mean(minePron_b_z),
    nppVerb_b_z = mean(nppVerb_b_z),
    npiVerb_b_z = mean(npiVerb_b_z),
    .by = alias)
d_person <- left_join(d_person, d_text_agg, by = "alias")
```

## Create correlation matrix of all person-level variables

```{r}
d_corr_person <- d_person[, c("PsychQOL_mean", "DASS_mean", "TAS_mean", "TEIQ_mean", "polarity_b_z", "distance_fullLIWC_b_z", "distance_partialLIWC_b_z", "distance_syntax_b_z",
                              "iLIWC_b_z", "iPron_b_z", "mePron_b_z", "minePron_b_z", "npLIWC_b_z", "nppVerb_b_z", "npiVerb_b_z")]
```

## Run OLS regression models

### predicting trait EI

```{r}
d_EI <- read_csv("TEIQ_merged_no duplicate responses_all columns_updated scores_fixed IDs.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
EI_scale_items <- d_EI[, c("TEIQ_1_E", "TEIQ_2_E_R", "TEIQ_3", "TEIQ_4_SC_R", "TEIQ_5_WB_R", "TEIQ_6_S", "TEIQ_7_SC_R", "TEIQ_8_E_R", "TEIQ_9_WB", "TEIQ_10_S_R",
                              "TEIQ_11_S", "TEIQ_12_WB_R", "TEIQ_13_E_R", "TEIQ_14_R", "TEIQ_15_SC", "TEIQ_16_E_R", "TEIQ_17_E", "TEIQ_18_R", "TEIQ_19_SC", "TEIQ_20_WB", 
                              "TEIQ_21_S", "TEIQ_22_SC_R", "TEIQ_23_E", "TEIQ_24_WB", "TEIQ_25_S_R", "TEIQ_26_S_R", "TEIQ_27_WB", "TEIQ_28_E_R", "TEIQ_29", "TEIQ_30_SC")]
reliability_alpha <- psych::alpha(EI_scale_items)
summary(reliability_alpha)
```

```{r}
df_EI <- as.data.frame(d_EI)
reliability_multilevel <- multilevel.reliability(df_EI, grp = "alias", Time = "Time", items = 3:32, lmer = TRUE)
print(reliability_multilevel)
```

```{r}
ols_EI_fullLIWC <- lm(TEIQ_mean ~ distance_fullLIWC_b_z * polarity_b_z, data=d_person)
summary(ols_EI_fullLIWC)
```

```{r}
ols_EI_partialLIWC <- lm(TEIQ_mean ~ distance_partialLIWC_b_z * polarity_b_z, data=d_person)

```

